answer: Each identity installs one key-bound wind-chill logger at an island oasis and locks a 70-credit bond. Each epoch it reports temperature and wind; an auditor recomputes wind chill from the tundra wind-chill table and burns the bond on a reading over 3% off, a repeated serial, or one logger for two identities. The first fee is 37, the kth pays 37+6(k-1), so the 1000th pays 6031 and 1000 fakes pay 3,034,000 plus 70,000 locked. A rented-logger ring fails because a rented logger carries another key and a registered serial. An honest identity pays 37 once and recovers the bond after one epoch.
